title: Title & Registration Services Standard for State Submission and State Dealer Deadlines
content:
## Submission

1. A Title & Registration Services order that is ready to submit is submitted within the service type's submission target business days.
2. The packet is submitted only when the purchase order balance is zero or below and, when the service type requires it, the purchase order shows insurance verified. Both facts are read from the purchase order record of the Vehicle Purchase Agreements matched to the title order, before the submission.
3. A fee is remitted only on an order whose status is submitted.
4. The following clause is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current remittance basis for returned packets: "Every held state fee is remitted with the submission as its own remittance entry."
5. Out-of-state packets for service types that go by mail are sent to the buyer's county office.
6. Once an order has reached the service type's maximum submissions, it is not submitted again by customer care; it is referred to the title escalations team. The submissions of an order are counted over its whole life: the first submission plus one more for every submission made after a state rejection.

## State dealer deadline

The state's dealer deadline for the registration state is counted in calendar days from the purchase agreement signing date as day 0, and is met when the first submission is made on or before its last day.

| Registration state | Dealer deadline (calendar days from signing, signing day being day 0) |
|---|---|
| AZ | 30 |
| TX | 30 |
| GA | 30 |
| FL | 30 |
| NC | 28 |
| OH | 30 |
| PA | 20 |
| CO | 30 |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| State | Signing date (day 0) | Last day of the deadline | First submission | Deadline |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PA | 1 March | 21 March | 21 March | met |
| PA | 1 March | 21 March | 22 March | missed |
| NC | 1 March | 29 March (non-leap year) | 29 March | met |
| NC | 1 March | 29 March (non-leap year) | 30 March | missed |

Only the first submission is compared with the deadline; a later resubmission does not change whether the deadline was met.

## Submission gate as a table

| Purchase order balance | Service type requires insurance verified | Purchase order shows insurance verified | Packet may be submitted |
|---|---|---|---|
| zero or below | no | either | yes |
| zero or below | yes | yes | yes |
| zero or below | yes | no | no |
| above zero | either | either | no |

superseded_clauses: Every held state fee is remitted with the submission as its own remittance entry.
